TransactionPassword.title: Transaction Password
TransactionPassword.subtitle: Manage your transaction PIN to protect withdrawals, transfers, and other sensitive fund operations.
TransactionPassword.security_desc: The transaction password is a 6-digit PIN required for sensitive fund operations such as withdrawals and transfers, providing an extra layer of security for your account.
TransactionPassword.password_desc_suffix: . It is required for withdrawals, large transfers, and other sensitive fund operations to protect your account.
security_tips: Do not use the same password as your login credentials.
Filix support will never ask for your transaction PIN.
Change your transaction PIN periodically to improve account security.
TransactionPassword.password_desc_set: Your transaction password is active. You can update it here.
TransactionPassword.password_desc_unset: You haven't set a transaction password yet. Set one now to secure your funds.

modal.title: Set Transaction Password
modal.verify_desc: For your account security, we'll send a verification code to your registered email.
modal.captcha_sent: Verification code sent to your email
modal.email_not_set_desc: Bind an email under Contact before setting your transaction password.
modal.send_failed: Failed to send verification code. Please try again.
modal.set_failed: Failed to set transaction password. Please try again.
modal.password_desc: Enter a 6-digit PIN for sensitive fund operations.
modal.mismatch_inline: PINs do not match. Please check and try again.
modal.success: Your transaction password has been set successfully.
modal.success_desc: You will be asked to enter this PIN when performing sensitive operations like withdrawals and transfers.
